dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature along the trailing edge, tapering from a broad base toward the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium pixel radius at the fin's highest vertical point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Acute convex slope measured at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is approximately 1.5 times the vertical height of the fin.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex arc with a large radius originating from the blowhole region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick visible beak with a length approximately equal to its height at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the pixel junction where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive bicolored dorsal fin (dark anterior, light posterior) and a high-contrast light-colored lateral stripe extending toward the flank.
